Container.Name: openjarvis
Container.Overview:
OpenJarvis personal AI assistant (jarvis serve): REST API and web UI on port 8000, running on cloud models only (Anthropic, Mistral or OpenAI key). Built from the BGameiro2000 fork of open-jarvis/OpenJarvis at a pinned commit.
Databases and config live in /data on the cache pool. All markdown memory (SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, USER.md, personas and notes) lives in /vault on the array, readable in Obsidian. Graph recall comes from the companion Cognee container on the same jarvis-net network.
Before installing: create the network (docker network create jarvis-net), set Settings, Docker, "Preserve user defined networks" to Yes, and install Cognee first. On first start the container generates an API key and prints it once in the log; paste it into the web UI Settings page. Expose on LAN or Tailscale only, never port-forward.
Container.Requires: Network jarvis-net (docker network create jarvis-net) and Docker setting "Preserve user defined networks: Yes". At least one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY.

Config.Name: Web UI and API port
Config.Description: REST API (/v1, /api) and web UI. LAN or Tailscale only.

Config.Name: Data (cache pool)
Config.Description: OPENJARVIS_HOME: config.toml, API key, credentials, skills, custom code, logs and every database. Use the pool path, not /mnt/user, so SQLite avoids the FUSE layer.

Config.Name: Vault (markdown memory)
Config.Description: Markdown memory volume on the array (share with Use cache pool: No). Source of truth for SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, USER.md, personas and notes. An empty share gets the folder skeleton on first start; nothing is ever overwritten.

Config.Name: OPENJARVIS_API_KEY
Config.Description: Key clients send as Authorization: Bearer KEY. Blank: generated on first start, stored in /data/.api_key and printed once in the log.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Anthropic key. When set, the first-start config uses Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6).

Config.Name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
Config.Description: Mistral key (through litellm). Used for the default model when no Anthropic key is set.

Config.Name: COGNEE_URL
Config.Description: Cognee API on jarvis-net. Blank disables the cognee_recall tool.

Config.Name: COGNEE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Same value as COGNEE_API_KEY in the Cognee container.

Config.Name: OPENJARVIS_OLLAMA_HOST
Config.Description: Optional remote Ollama URL (passed to OpenJarvis as OLLAMA_HOST). Leave blank: no local models here.

Config.Name: OPENJARVIS_CUSTOM_MODULES
Config.Description: Comma separated Python modules from /data/custom to import before the server starts (agents, tools). Blank: none.
